title: 12 Best Sushi Restaurants in Tokyo
description: Discover Tokyo's best sushi spots for 2026, from Michelin-starred omakase to bustling market eateries and modern conveyor belt experiences. Find your perfect bite in Japan's culinary capital.

places.name: Sushi Arai
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The seasonal omakase course, trusting Chef Arai's daily selections of nigiri and otsumami.

places.name: Sushi Sawada
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The only option is the omakase, a meticulously curated journey through seasonal delicacies.

places.name: Sushi Yoshitake
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The meticulously crafted omakase menu, which typically includes an exquisite array of nigiri and a few seasonal appetizers.

places.name: Sushi Sho
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'otsumami and nigiri' omakase course, which features a compelling mix of small cooked dishes and expertly crafted sushi.

places.name: Sushi Dai
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Omakase Course' (Chef's Choice) is the best value, offering a parade of seasonal nigiri and a chance to try something unique.

places.name: Daiwa Sushi
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Chef's Omakase' set, which typically includes 7-8 pieces of nigiri, a sushi roll, and miso soup.

places.name: Midori Sushi (Umegaoka Honten)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Tokujyo Nigiri' (Special Premium Nigiri) set for a fantastic selection of high-quality pieces, or their famously large Anago (sea eel) nigiri.

places.name: Sushizanmai Honten
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their specialty Maguro (Tuna) selection, especially the O-toro (fatty tuna), and whatever seasonal fish is recommended on the day.

places.name: Uobei
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Anything that catches your eye from the extensive touch-screen menu, including classic nigiri, inventive rolls, and even side dishes.

places.name: Itamae Sushi Edo
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try their 'Itamae Omakase' set or pick individual nigiri and sashimi. Their aburi (torched) sushi is particularly popular.

places.name: Katsumidori Seibu Shibuya
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their famous 'three kinds of tuna' plate, or any of their daily specials which are often unique and seasonal.

places.name: Nemuro Hanamaru (KITTE Marunouchi)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Look for seasonal Hokkaido catches like 'Sanma' (Pacific saury) or 'Hotate' (scallops), and their signature 'Kani Miso' (crab paste).
